name: architecture-drawing
description: Agent 读取项目文档并产出 ArchitectureModel，确定性代码生成原生可编辑的 PowerPoint 架构图；输出只有 pptx。
capabilities: document preparation for docx, markdown and txt with source locators
bounded extraction of untrusted documents (size, part count and block limits)
layered band layout with flow ordering and barycenter column alignment
orthogonal routing with native arrow heads and label collision avoidance
editable PPTX rendering with priority/status visual weight
theme data files and reference style contract
OOXML gradient, transparency, shadow and glow effects

exit_codes.2: validation failed, input rejected, or evidence insufficient
